items.signature: fn parse_literal<T>(expr: &datafusion_expr::Expr) -> datafusion_common::Result<T::Native> where T: ArrowPrimitiveType, T::Native: TryFrom<datafusion_common::ScalarValue, Error = datafusion_common::DataFusionError>
